quick_english: Now the ninth chapter. The blessed Lord said: I will declare to the non-envious this most secret knowledge together with realized knowledge; knowing it, you will be freed from the inauspicious. Non-enviousness is the chief cause in the transmission of knowledge, as before in knowledge and realization.

quick_english: I pervade this whole world in unmanifest form; all beings stand in me, yet I am not situated in them. Even considering for long that all beings stand in me, there is no other support-abode; in their appearance, the opposite knowledge-nature is concealed by making inert form preceded by the known self-nature. Thus it is said: I am not situated in them.

Beings do not dwell in me; see my divine yoga. I bear beings, yet my self, though sustaining beings, does not dwell in them. The ignorant, blind to truth, think the supreme Lord is limited, seeing only a finite self on earth; but the Lord's yoga is unsurpassed sovereign freedom.

quick_english: Thus indeed I move unseen in all beings, resting on being-nature, together and without; as space and wind remain inseparable yet sky is never touched, so the Lord's principle, though spread through all world, is not an object for everyone.

quick_english: All beings, son of Kunti, go to my nature at world-dissolution; again at world-beginning I emit those beings into unmanifest nature.

Taking hold of my own nature, I emit again and again this entire helpless group of beings by nature's control; by this much, even this inert group of beings has obtained manifestness through connection with the higher nature.

quick_english: With me as overseer, nature produces moving and still things; by this cause, son of Kunti, the world revolves. There is no action-bondage for me by indifference, because I exist; therefore I am cause in world-creation without relying on activity.

quick_english: Great souls, resorting to divine nature, worship with unwavering mind, knowing the imperishable origin of beings.
Always glorifying, striving, vowed, bowing, and ever united, they worship with devotion.
Some worship by knowledge-sacrifice as one, others by external offerings in many ways; all are devoted to the Lord.

The Lord is the goal, supporter, witness, dwelling, refuge, friend, origin, dissolution, abode, treasure, and imperishable seed.

quick_english: Thus, one who knows in the stated order finds even an offering to Indra and other gods to be an offering to the supreme lord; every other action too becomes worship of the great lord as one's own self. quick_english: Thus you will be freed from the bonds of action by auspicious and inauspicious fruits; united with renunciation-yoga and freed, you will approach me. This indeed is renunciation-yoga, already stated extensively and almost clearly before.

quick_english: How much more so holy brahmins and devoted royal sages; having obtained this impermanent, unhappy world, worship me.

Fix your mind on me, become my devotee and worshipper, bow to me, and you will come to me alone. Even those born in sinful wombs, animals, birds, reptiles, women, vaiśyas, śūdras, and dependent persons who take refuge in me worship me alone. The supremely compassionate Lord's deeds, such as the liberation of the elephant king, are heard in thousands. Some interpret the verse as praise of twice-born and kṣatriyas, not as an intent of liberation for women and others; they fragment the Lord's all-gracious power and cannot endure His supreme compassion. The Lord has no enemy and no dear one, even one of evil conduct. Other clear statements are contradicted by those who forcibly introduce difference into the nondual essence of the Lord and ignore scriptural contradictions. When questioned, those deeply immersed in caste obsession, envy, shame, and crooked gaze impute comic rasa to the false prattle of all people. The commentary makes all auspicious.
